## Summary

The change threads the actual, sanitized task-tracker storage path into the system prompt. All work is in source files only — no test files touched.

**`packages/core/src/config/storage.ts`** — `getProjectTempTrackerDir()` already existed and correctly returns the absolute filesystem path (`path.join(getProjectTempDir(), [sessionId,] 'tracker')`), so no change was needed there.

**`packages/core/src/prompts/promptProvider.ts`** (`PromptProvider.getCoreSystemPrompt`):
- Checks `context.config.isTrackerEnabled()`.
- When enabled, calls `context.config.storage.getProjectTempTrackerDir()` and sanitizes it: `.replace(/\n/g, ' ').replace(/\]/g, '')` (newlines → spaces, `]` removed).
- Passes it through the new `taskTrackerDir` option (and leaves `taskTracker` as the enable flag). When disabled, `taskTrackerDir` is `undefined` and the section is omitted entirely.

**`packages/core/src/prompts/snippets.ts`** and **`snippets.legacy.ts`** (both modern and legacy paths):
- Added `taskTrackerDir?: string` to `SystemPromptOptions`.
- `renderTaskTracker(trackerDir?)` now interpolates the dynamic path into the `located at \`{trackerDir}\`` phrase within `# TASK MANAGEMENT PROTOCOL` (falling back to `.tracker/tasks/`).
- The composition still gates the whole section on `options.taskTracker`, so a disabled tracker produces no protocol section.

The `getCoreSystemPrompt(config: Config): string` wrapper signature in `packages/core/src/core/prompts.ts` is unchanged.
